meta_note: All routes are prefixed with /api/budget and protected by ApiGuard (JWT bearer). Requests are forwarded to the Finance microservice via gRPC. Route order matters: /archived and /:id/restore are declared before /:id to prevent NestJS from matching 'archived' as an :id param.

getBudgets.description: List all budgets active during the given month/year for the authenticated user, including per-budget spend and unbudgeted categories with their spend totals. Budgets deactivated before or at the start of the requested period are excluded.

budgets.name: string
budgets.amount: number — effective limit for the requested period (BudgetHistory entry active at periodStart); falls back to current budget.amount if no history entry covers the period

getSpendingTrend.description: Return monthly EXPENSE totals (overall and per-category) for the last N months. Used to render the spending trend chart on the Budget page.

input.months: query param (optional, default 6) — lookback window; one of 3, 6, or 12

data.label: string — e.g. 'Jan 2026'
data.total: number — sum of all EXPENSE transactions for this month

getArchivedBudgets.description: Returns all soft-deleted (deactivated) budgets for the authenticated user, ordered newest-deactivated first. Used to populate the archived budgets management sheet where users can restore or permanently delete individual budgets.

getBudget.description: Retrieve a single budget by ID including its full amount-change history, ordered oldest-first. The `spent` field is scoped to the period defined by `month` and `year` so viewing a past period always returns the correct historical spend.

input.month: query param (required) — 0-indexed month used to scope the spent total
input.year: query param (required) — full four-digit year used to scope the spent total

budget.name: string
budget.amount: number — effective limit for the requested period (BudgetHistory entry active at periodStart); falls back to current budget.amount if no history entry covers the period

createBudget.description: Create a new budget or re-activate a previously deactivated one for the same category+period. Uses an upsert on the unique (userId, categorySlug, period) index. On re-activation `deactivatedAt` is cleared, core fields are refreshed, and a new BudgetHistory entry is opened — prior history is preserved. Provide `month` (0-indexed) and `year` to backdate the budget period.

input.name: string (required)
input.categorySlug: string (required) — slug of the category to track
input.alertThreshold: number (optional, 0–1) — fraction of budget consumed before alert fires
input.alertAtFrequency: number (optional, 1–30) — days between re-alerts after threshold breach

data.name: string
data.deactivatedAt: null — always null on a freshly created or re-activated budget

updateBudget.description: Update an existing budget. `month` and `year` are required and anchor the period for SCD history tracking — they must match the period the user is editing. When `amount` changes, the history entry for that period is updated in-place if it matches the current active entry, or a new entry is opened if the period has rolled over.

input.month: body (required) — 0-indexed month the user is viewing
input.year: body (required) — full year the user is viewing
input.name: string (optional)

restoreBudget.description: Restores a soft-deleted (deactivated) budget. Clears `deactivatedAt` and reopens a BudgetHistory entry for the current period. If a history entry already exists for that period start it is reopened in place rather than creating a duplicate.

input.id: path param (required) — ID of the archived budget to restore

deleteBudget.description: Deactivates or permanently deletes a budget. hardDelete=false (default): soft-deactivates from the current server month — budget is hidden from the current month onwards but visible for past periods; can be restored. hardDelete=true: permanently removes the Budget row and all BudgetHistory rows (cascade delete). Irreversible.

input.hardDelete: query param (optional, default false) — true = permanent cascade delete; false = soft-deactivate from current month

export_cache_invalidation.description: Successful budget mutations invalidate all Redis keys export:{userId}:* (fire-and-forget) so analytics exports regenerate on the next request.
